summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K disclosing an underwriting agreement with MST Financial Services to underwrite the exercise of up to 8,400,000 unexercised ATHO listed options ahead of expiry on 31 August 2026. Option exercise price is A$0.50 per share, raising between A$4.2 million and A$7.96 million before costs. Proceeds fund Phase 3 trial of ATH434. Underwriter receives 7% fee; underwriting is subject to customary conditions and termination events. Watch for completion and share issuance overhang.
